## Leave Request Approval Bot
Checks balance, team coverage and blackout dates, then auto-approves the easy ones and routes the rest.

Staff fill a hosted form ('off from 12th to 16th October'). Dates are read from free text, working days counted without weekends and holidays, then balance, blackout periods and minimum team cover are checked. CFG holds balances and approved leave; in production load them from a sheet and write approvals back.

**Try it:** click *Test workflow* to run on the sample data. Then connect your credentials on the output nodes and activate.

Code and docs: github.com/Princewill106/leave-request-approval-bot
